Subject: Re: Fwd: Commercial counter: onramp + pilot pricing

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks for the summary and the memo. I ran a quick model against our standard pilot SKU and the Lumena usage profile you pasted: 

- Baseline ARR (list): $420k
- 25% concession on list reduces ARR to ~$315k for year 1; net margin impact ~ -21 ppts when accounting for infra uplift and expected KV cache inefficiencies during pilot.
- 20% concession with prepayment (60% of year) improves NPV by ~8% vs full monthly billing.
- 90-day opt-out materially reduces downside risk; 6-month opt-out leaves a longer tail of potential churn.

Recommendation for exec escalation: ask for conditional approval for 20% first-year discount + 60% prepayment OR 25% discount only if Lumena agrees to a non-cancellable 9-month minimum and acceptance of our Data Residency Addendum (we should not agree to VPC without security/infra sign-off).

I added projected P&L lines to the memo and flagged legal/infra items under 'must-have' checklist. Given their board timeline, if you want a quick VP/CFO decision, I suggest we prepare: 1) brief exec memo (one pager) 2) redline of the counter 3) statement of infra/security gating items.

Kimberly Park
Head of RevOps, Redwood Inference
